snippet.title: Ever War Game Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist on steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3757480/Ever_War/
Follow development update on bsky: https://bsky.app/profile/700ae.bsky.social
Join our Discord: https://discord.gg/4GSJwTF2

Ever War is a turn-based strategy game set in the medieval fantasy world. This game combines empire-building, resource management and large-scale tactical turn-based battles.

music used: Battle in the winter by Johan Brodd
